title: Get Out
synopsis: A photographer meets his girlfriend's family, a kitchen full of help, a teacup that puts him through the floor, and a basement with a slide projector.

nodes.text: A small bag, a kiss, a question about whether her parents know you are Black.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Ask” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Skip it” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Polite.

nodes.text: Rod pulls up in a white SUV and you get in and the gates close behind you and the house goes silent for the first time in a hundred years.
You drag a candle through the parlor and the photographs flutter and the house lights up against a cold sky, and the lawn fills with confused neighbors.
Walter, with the gun, salutes you once and turns it on the patriarch in the doorway. You drive away from a porch that has, finally, stopped smiling.
